name: No tests

blockers.description: No tests/ directory, no test configuration, and no test step in CI exist anywhere in the repository.

acceptable_extra_findings.note: Observation that CI only lints and never runs tests is acceptable as supporting context for the same underlying gap.

forbidden_findings.note: No tests exist at all, so none can be failing or broken; that claim would fabricate a proven breakage that was never observed. This is a severity-calibration trap: escalating to critical/failing is unsupported.
The recorded CI run for this ref succeeded (lint-only); claiming CI failed is false.

notes: Development case testing severity calibration: absence of verification is high, not critical, because no breakage is proven.
